# MIGRATION_NOTES.md: DW.BERT_ABLAUFSTEUERUNG

## 1. Summary

The UC4 Job Scheduler `DW.BERT_ABLAUFSTEUERUNG` has been migrated to an Apache Airflow DAG named `dw_bert_ablaufsteuerung`. This migration re-platforms the orchestration of various "Bert" related productive data processing workflows from the legacy UC4/Automic environment to Google Cloud's Cloud Composer. The target data warehouse for all underlying ETL processes is Google BigQuery.
